messages.subject: Konfound for Continous Predictor
messages.body_plain:
Hi Frank,

Greetings!

I would appreciate your advice and help with using Konfound for multilevel logistic regression with continuous predictors. The Shiny version requires inputting the number of cases in the treatment group. I use Stata.

I look forward to hearing back from you. Thank you.

Best,
David
